Turn One Page at a Time

With fading page turns, pages don't slide: the next one fades in where you are, easier on the eyes when turning quickly. With Fade Follows the Finger, a swipe uncovers the next page from under your finger while the pages stay in place; letting go turns the page or goes back, by how far and how fast you swiped.
